newsitem.title: USA: Abiomed adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Abiomed adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Abiomed Inc said Thursday its directors adopted a shareholder purchase rights plan and has declared a distribution of preferred purchase Rights to shareholders of record at the close of business on August 28, 1997.
The rights will initially trade with the company's common stock and separate rights certificates will not be issued.

Abiomed said the rights plan is designed to deter coercive or unfair takeover tactics and to ensure that all Abiomed shareholders receive fair and equal treatment in the event of an unsolicited attempt to acquire the corporation.
The Rights Plan was not adopted in response to any effort to acquire Abiomed, and the Board is not aware of any such effort, the company said.
